verdict.rationale: Tilled's payouts docs show a per-merchant "payout speed" setting that can be viewed in the Dashboard. That suggests payout timing varies by seller, but the evidence only describes viewing it, not configuring it. Batch close via API concerns transaction settlement rather than seller payout scheduling, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented daily/weekly/monthly/manual schedule options, evidence that ops can configure payout schedules per seller, instant payouts to cards or real-time rails, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, payouts run on the schedule each seller needs — daily, weekly, monthly, or manual, plus instant payouts to cards or real-time rails where supported, configurable per seller

citations.quote: To view a merchant’s payout speed in the Dashboard
